Dear Dr. Spears:

Greetings.

Please excuse me for not being able to contact you as frequently as I usually did before my "redirection." Since last November, I have been on foreign trips 4 times, and I am about to leave for Taiwan and Beijing this week. Certainly, tobacco is still one of my central activities.

This letter is to introduce you to tobacco specialists from China National Tobacco Cooperation, Peoples Republic of China, led by Mr. Fang Chuanbin, now visiting USA under sponsorship of the A. C. Monk & Co. Inc., North Carolina. Mr. Fang was a student at the University of Maryland in 1981. Their current tour will take approximately 4 months. A. C. Monk & Co. has arranged for them to take part, observe, and visit various tobacco operations in the States, including USDA's grading and marketing service in Raleigh, North Carolina; North Carolina State tobacco farmers organizations; Stabilization cooperation; Burley Tobacco in Kentucky; Marketing Systems; processing facilities; and manufacturing facilities. They will also attend some seminars specially prepared for them by A. C. Monk & Co.

I understand that Mr. Fang's group will be in North Carolina in the Middle part of May, and in Kentucky in June. A. C. Monk & Co. will make detailed arrangements directly with respective parties.

I am sure they will be honored to have an opportunity to visit with you and your associates while at your location. Any courtesy you can extend to them will be deeply appreciated. The Director Generals of China Tobacco Monopoly and National Tobacco Cooperation are my old friends, and they asked that I extend their thanks to you in advance.

87683148

With best regards,

[SIGNATURE]

T. C. TSO
NPS Collaborator
Tobacco & Health
